transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… people at work got scared, I guess. I’m a waitress, and during service I’ve been… freezing up. Like I’ll just stand by the soda station holding the cash drawer key, repeating table numbers instead of closing checks. Or I do things in the wrong order. It’s been causing problems.
Have you ever felt like your mind is playing tricks on you, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don’t?

Sometimes… yeah. I hear a woman say my name, or say I’m counting wrong. Like at closing, or when I’m in my kitchen at home. It’s clear enough that I’ll answer, and then… I realize no one else heard it.
Have there been times when you believed something strongly that others around you didn’t seem to understand or agree with, even when they said it wasn’t true?

Yeah… I guess. At work I keep thinking a couple of the servers, and this one regular, are watching how I ring things in. Like they leave little marks or signs on the tickets to show I messed up… or to get me fired.

My husband says it’s just normal restaurant mix-ups, but it doesn’t really feel that way to me.
Do you feel like certain people are sending you hidden messages or trying to harm you in some way, beyond just watching your work mistakes?

I don’t know about harm exactly… but it feels like more than just watching. Like a couple servers and one regular leave little signs on the tickets, like they’re trying to prove I messed up so I’ll get fired. My husband says it’s just normal restaurant stuff, but… I can’t shake it.
Do you ever feel like your actions or thoughts are being controlled by something outside of yourself, like someone else is making you do or say things?

Not really like… being controlled. It’s more that I feel like people at work are watching what I do, like how I ring things in. A couple servers, and one regular… I keep thinking they’re leaving signs on the tickets to show I messed up, like they want me fired. My husband says it’s just normal mistakes, but it doesn’t feel that way.
Do you ever feel like things happening around you—like things people say, or events on TV or the radio—are directed at you specifically, even if others don’t see it that way?

Not really TV or radio… I don’t think so. It’s more at work. Like the way some tickets come back, or little marks on them… it feels like they’re meant for me, like the servers or that regular are trying to show I messed up. My husband says I’m reading into it, but it doesn’t feel random.
Have you ever felt like things people say or do in public, like on TV, in conversations, or in other places, are meant specifically for you, even if others don’t seem to notice it that way?

Not really TV or anything like that. It’s mostly at the restaurant… like some of the servers, and one regular, I feel like they’re watching how I ring things in. Sometimes the tickets have little marks or notes and it feels like they’re trying to show I messed up, like to get me fired. My husband says it’s just normal stuff, but… I don’t know.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts aren’t entirely your own, like someone is putting thoughts into your mind or removing them?
No… I don’t think so. My thoughts feel like mine, I guess. I haven’t noticed anyone putting things in my head or taking them out.
Outside of work, have you ever felt like things people say or do—like conversations, signs, or events—are meant specifically for you, even if others don’t seem to notice it that way?

Outside of work… not really. I don’t usually feel that with signs or strangers talking. It’s mostly at the restaurant, with a couple servers and that one regular customer… like they’re watching how I ring things in, or leaving little signs on the tickets. My husband says it’s just normal mess-ups, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being taken out of your head or that someone is putting thoughts into your mind that aren't yours?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, my thoughts feel like they’re mine. I haven’t really had that happen.
Have you ever felt like things people say or do in places other than work—like conversations, signs, or events—are meant specifically for you, even if others don’t seem to notice it that way?

No… not really outside of work. It’s mainly at the restaurant. Like I said, with a couple servers and that regular customer… the tickets and mistakes feel like they’re meant for me, like they’re trying to show something or get me in trouble. But other places, I don’t really notice that.
Have you ever felt like things people say or do in places other than work—like conversations, signs, or events—are meant specifically for you, even if others don’t seem to notice it that way?

No… like I said, it’s really just at work. The servers and that one regular customer… I feel like they watch how I ring things in, and sometimes the tickets have little signs on them. It feels like they’re trying to prove something or get me fired, even if my husband says it’s just normal restaurant stuff.
Have you ever experienced any strange or unusual beliefs that you know other people might find hard to believe, even if they aren't related to being watched or targeted at work?
Um… no, I don’t think so. Nothing like that really comes to mind. It’s mostly just… the work stuff I’ve already mentioned.
Have you ever believed something that you know most people wouldn’t agree with or find strange, even if it wasn’t related to your concerns at work?

Not really outside of that. I mean… the main thing is still at work, with a couple servers and that regular customer. I keep feeling like they’re watching how I ring things in, and the tickets have little signs on them, like they’re trying to prove something or get me fired. My husband says it’s just normal mistakes, but… it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Have you ever had any strange or unusual beliefs that lasted for a long time, even if they weren’t related to work or what was happening around you?

Not really… not outside of work. It’s just that thing I said, with the servers and that regular customer watching how I ring things in, and the little signs on the tickets. It’s been going on a while, even if my husband says it’s just normal mess-ups.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions about people or events outside of work that you know others might not understand or agree with?

Outside of work… no, not really. It’s mostly that same thing at the restaurant. Like the servers and that one regular watching what I’m ringing in, and the tickets having… little signs on them. I know my husband says it’s just normal mistakes, but it doesn’t feel that way.

Even though your husband and others have told you these mistakes are normal and that you’re not being targeted, can you shake the feeling that these signs on the tickets are really meant for you, or does it feel just as real no matter what others say?

I… I try to tell myself maybe it’s just mistakes, like my husband says. But no, I can’t really shake it. When I see the tickets, it feels like they’re meant for me… like the servers and that regular are watching and trying to show something so I’ll get fired. It still feels real.

Even though your husband and others have told you these mistakes are normal and that you’re not being targeted, can you shake the feeling that these signs on the tickets are really meant for you, or does it feel just as real no matter what others say?

I know what people say, but… no, it doesn’t really go away. When I see those tickets, it feels like they’re leaving signs for me. Like they’re watching how I ring things in and trying to prove something so I’ll get fired.
